summary: Re-orders championship standings after a race result. When the entry count at obj+0x3E14 is positive, builds a linked list of sort nodes (driver index, stored value, planned position) from per-entry flag bits and the value table, merge-sorts the list by value, writes fresh sequential positions into the dword_5F0730 grid up to dword_7C9530, writes the final positions back into the standings object at offsets 0x3FD6/0x3FD9, then frees every allocated node.

operations.description: Guard on the entry count at obj+0x3E14 being greater than 0; the linked-list build loop only runs when at least one entry exists.

Iterate driver entries: test bit 2 of the per-entry flag field (offset 916) via FlagBitTest to decide whether the driver has a valid result; when set, read the driver index from offset 1040, otherwise use -1.

Allocate a 12-byte sort node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and store driver index, the per-entry value read from the value table (initial offset 15476, stride 4), and the planned position looked up from dword_5F0730 at index 4656 * driverIndex.
Allocate a 12-byte list node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, link it after the previous tail, and increment the node counter.
Merge-sort the built linked list with LinkedListMergeSort_47d0 so entries are ordered by their stored value.
Walk to the tail of the sorted list by following the next-node link at offset 4 of each node.
Write fresh sequential positions (starting at 1) into the dword_5F0730 grid, advancing by 4656 dwords per entry until the end pointer dword_7C9530 is reached.

Walk the sorted list again writing each entry's stored value to the standings object at offset 16342 (4 * position + *v1) and the new position into dword_5F0730 indexed by driver; then write the final re-ordered count as a byte at offset 16345.
Free every list node and, when the node's payload flag (byte at offset 8) is set, also free the contained sort node, using FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Return the standings object base pointer (*this).
Called by MultiplayerVehiclePlacement (0x0042CF10) to re-order championship standings after a race result.
